subject: Request: comp-band exception + headcount approval for runtime infra candidate
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: comp-band exception + headcount approval for runtime infra candidate

Team —

We have an offer acceptance pending with Alex Davis (external recruiter: Elena Rivera) for a Senior Runtime Engineer (infra/platform focus). Recruiting is asking for a comp-band exception: Alex is commanding higher base than the posted Staff+ bands due to a rare systems background (low-latency streaming runtimes + CUDA kernel experience) and an active offer from a competitor.

Asking for two approvals in parallel so we can move quickly:
1) Headcount approval to convert a pending HC slot (Q2 runtime headcount pool) to a dedicated hire for runtime infra (req 2027-RT-18).
2) Compensation band exception: base above standard band by up to 12% + signing bonus. I'll attach the candidate resume and the formal comp-band exception form.

Why this matters: Alex fills a gap in our low-latency inference stack (has prior KV cache and batching work at scale). Hiring delay risks losing them; the recruiting team recommends rapid approval to beat the other offer (deadline EOD Thursday).

Ask: Laura/Marcus — can you greenlight the HC move + exception (or provide guidance on alternative levers — e.g., stronger signing bonus, shorter probation bump) by EOD Wed? Jonas, looping you for budget routing and to record for the exec headcount ledger.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: comp-band exception + headcount approval for runtime infra candidate

Karthik —

Thanks for the context and the packet. I reviewed Alex's resume and the exception form. Quick thoughts:
- I am comfortable approving the headcount conversion from the Q2 pool to a named hire for runtime infra. Please update the HC tracker (JIRA-HR-4521).
- For compensation, I'm willing to approve up to 8% above band baseline in base pay. If you need to go to 12%, we should route that to exec comp (Marcus + Jon) for sign-off; I want to preserve parity for recent hires.
- If Marcus is OK, we can accelerate and approve today so recruiting can close.

Please include the proposed total comp package (base, sign-on, equity target, expected start date) in your next note.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: comp-band exception + headcount approval for runtime infra candidate

Laura/Karthik —

I reviewed the resume and comp request. Given the urgency and the strategic gap Alex closes, I'm OK approving the full 12% band uplift but with a condition: tie 50% of the uplift to a six-month performance milestone (latency regression analysis + a memory/KV cache improvement checklist). If milestones not met, we revert to standard band and prorate the uplift.

I want HR to document the milestone language in the offer letter addendum. Jonas — please confirm this is feasible from a budget and payroll perspective.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 13:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: comp-band exception + headcount approval for runtime infra candidate

Marcus/Team —

Budget check: we can flex the requested 12% uplift within Q2 runtime hiring budget if we close this week and mark the position as a priority fill. HR payroll side — milestone-tied pay is fine, but HR/Legal will need explicit language. I've added this to JIRA-HR-4521 and flagged for payroll routing.

I'll approve the HC conversion and release the slot once I see the signed comp exception form (attached) and written milestone language.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rivera <elena@talentpartners.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Davis <alex.davis@example.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate acceptance contingent on comp band exception — Alex Davis

Karthik/Laura —

Alex has requested formal confirmation of the revised package before withdrawing from the other offer. Proposed package from recruiting:
- Base: $185,000 (12% above published band baseline of $165k)
- Signing bonus: $20,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.35% (standard for senior/runtime hires)
- Start date: May 3, 2027
- Conditional uplift: 50% of the 12% uplift paid at offer, remaining 50% vested after 6-month milestone (as discussed by Marcus).

Candidate note (from Alex): "The technical fit and Redwood's product roadmap are the key reasons I'm excited — I can commit to the milestone plan and a May start if we get the paperwork in place this week."

Attached: candidate resume and the signed comp-exception form (PDF stub).

Thanks —
Elena Rivera
Senior Recruiter, TalentPartners

--
Attachment stubs: candidate-resume-alex-davis.pdf (pdf, 220KB), offer-comp-band-exception-form.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
